introduction: “A Husband to Die For: The Lisa Aguilar Story” is an upcoming Lifetime television film scheduled to begin production in late April 2025 in Ottawa, Ontario. The narrative centers on a pregnant woman who discovers her husband’s infidelity and his unwillingness to embrace fatherhood, leading him to consider drastic measures to avoid responsibility.
